data.name: Ajeebah
data.gender_notes: Ajeebah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Ajeebah is a unique and mysterious name in Arabic originating from the Islamic religion. It is derived from the word 'ajeeb', meaning strange, unusual or marvelous. This name is perfect for a baby girl who is expected to bring wonder and surprise into the world. The name Ajeebah carries the meaning “Mysterious, Unusual” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Ajeebah usually hope their child will grow to embody mysterious, unusual and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Ajeebah is a spiritual name that represents the unknown, the mysterious and the unexplored. It is a reminder of the vastness and complexity of the universe and the infinite possibilities that lie within it. This name inspires a sense of curiosity and exploration, encouraging the bearer to delve deep into the mysteries of life and the universe.
data.etymology: Ajeebah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Mysterious, Unusual.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ajeebah total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

The meaning 'strange or unusual' is often associated with magical, supernatural or fantastical elements in Middle Eastern folklore. There have been tales of jinns (supernatural beings) and entities possessing strange powers, as well as legends of marvelous phenomenons or landmarks. The name Ajeebah pays homage to these aspects of Arabic culture and adds a touch of mystery and intrigue.

Muslim theology emphasizes the beauty, depth and mystery within creation, as reveled in the Quran. This name reflects an appreciation of God's grand design, as well as an encouragement to embrace the wonders and challenges of life with an open heart. It reminds us that just as there is magic and mystery in the natural world, there is also magic and mystery in the spiritual world that we can explore through peaceful contemplation and devotion.
